provider_notes: Europe PMC discovery was used after OpenAlex and then Crossref returned HTTP 429 during this session.
Europe PMC is biomedical-weighted; Crossref/official sources and foundational-method references were separately verified to reduce source-ecology bias.
Metadata records were screened for terminology and candidate discovery only; contract support requires separate full-text, abstract, or official-source reading.
summary.deduplication: Records are preserved within each query to keep query-level provenance; selected contract sources are deduplicated separately by DOI/title.
